promotion_note:
PROMOTED 2026-08-07 (nyiso-131). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-07-nyiso-131-taxgs-arm (bundle results/calibration/nyiso131_taxgs_arm), superseding 2026-08-06-nyiso-128-solar-basis. OWNER DECISION D-27, SIGNED at the 2026-08-06 sitting Addendum AA.4 (2026-08-07), verbatim: “D-27 — SIGNED AS RECOMMENDED: NYISO promotes now, MISO defers.” NO SOLVE RAN and NO MECHANISM WAS TESTED — this is a GOVERNANCE promotion over committed artifacts, adjudicating a pair that was already registered and scored under the Addendum-D HOLD-PROMOTION discipline (docs/handoffs/taxonomy-gas-st-2026-08-07.md §4.1).

WHAT THE ARM IS: THE nyiso-128 RECIPE ON THE CORRECTED FUEL TAXONOMY, NOT A NEW RECIPE. The genealogy is carried forward intact — 2026-08-07-nyiso-131-taxgs-arm is a same-head replay_keeper of the incumbent keeper's own bundle (nyiso128_treatment) with D-25 applied, so nyiso_solar_market_generator_basis and every other armed mechanism of the nyiso-128 lineage (nyiso-100 SIL retirement -> 109 zonal gas-offer anchor -> 117 NYC RCPF -> 118 ORDC measured step span -> 119 SENY increment -> 120 East River scope gate -> 125 seam envelope -> 128 solar basis) remain armed unchanged. VERIFIED, not asserted: of the 698 scenario_config fields in the arm, the 693 shared with the keeper are IDENTICAL (zero differing), and the 5 arm-only fields are ScenarioConfig entries that landed on main after the keeper solved, ALL FIVE AT DEFAULT False — including nyiso_li_tsl_n11_security, the nyiso-130 lever REJECTED on its own kill gate, which is confirmed NOT armed here.

WHAT D-25 CHANGES: natural-gas steam turbines (EIA-860 prime mover ST, energy source NG) map to the dedicated gas_st fuel — the fuel the CAMPD bin path always carried via BIN_GROUP_TO_FUEL — instead of folding into gas_ct. A rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] accurate-data correction: the class structure was already right (classify_plant has had ST_GAS/ST_CHP all along) and only the FUEL LABEL on the loader record was wrong, where it set the heat-rate fallback, VOM, EFORd, CO2/NOx and the SCORING-TARGET fuel. NYISO's entire solve-affecting residue is ONE synthesized-bin heat rate — the RED-Rochester ST_CHP bin, 11.454 -> 10.3 MMBtu/MWh on 119.6 MW, whose HEAT_RATE_BINS fallback moves from the gas_ct vintage bins to the gas_st bin. Zero free parameters; zero ScenarioConfig fields (the fix is unflagged, so rule 28 books no matrix row — CI's mechanism-matrix-guard checks the ScenarioConfig half and there is no new field).

THE PROMOTION IS ON RULE 14 AND THE RESIDUAL DELIBERATELY DID NOT MOVE. The accurate taxonomy is the truthful fleet representation, and the incumbent keeper embeds the superseded heat rate, so any future replay at HEAD already runs reclassed — promoting aligns the designated keeper with the code that would reproduce it. VERDICT GRAIN: NOTHING MOVES. Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS in BOTH arms, all 8 criterion statuses identical (C1/C2/C3a/C3b/C4/C6/C8 PASS, C3c the same lone ledgered caveat), caveat budget identical at 1 of 1. HOURLY GRAIN: not byte-identical, and the deltas are reported at full size rather than rounded away — demand-weighted ΔLMP -0.013 / -0.023 / -0.002 $/MWh for 2023/24/25, max zonal |ΔLMP| 1.25 / 3.85 / 2.71, and the largest class-energy move 0.052 TWh (ST_CHP 2024). 34 of 188 numeric verdict fields move; NO GATE IS APPROACHED, LET ALONE CROSSED. Direction is PHYSICAL and was predicted from the sign of the correction: the corrected (cheaper, EIA Table 8.2) heat rate lets the cogen bin run more, displacing merchant CC and the ST_GAS class.

D-5(b) RE-KEY DISCHARGED, DETERMINATION RE-VERIFIED WITHOUT A SOLVE. NYISO holds `complete`, so rule 22 D-5(b) requires the marker's keeper field to re-key AND its determination to be re-verified against the new run before this commit lands. Run: scripts/calibration_verdict.py --run-id 2026-08-07-nyiso-131-taxgs-arm, committed artifacts only. RESULT: CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS — IDENTICAL to the incumbent, so the worse-determination STOP DOES NOT FIRE and no escalation is owed. The only visible difference across the two scorer runs is a SKIPPED diagnostic line (C3a-2023 DA diagnostic +6.7% -> +6.6%), which is not a gated quantity. The C3c ledger is carried forward UNCHANGED IN SUBSTANCE: 2023 model 22h vs RT actual 10h (2.20×, OVER-produced, in-training, under the nyiso-130 owner directive) and 2024 model 3h vs 12h (0.25×, under-produced). No new caveat slot is spent — an input correction with zero free parameters creates no caveat.

WHAT THIS PROMOTION DOES NOT DO. It does NOT close, narrow or re-open C3c: the tail counts are the incumbent's and the diagnosed owner is unchanged — 100 % of the modelled tail in all three years is Long Island inside HB14-21 with BOTH Zone-K import paths at their bound, and the successor remains the CHARTERED joint reconciliation of the transfer bound and the downstate ST_GAS min_gen floor under rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH] (the bare 940 MW number swap was pre-registered, tested and REJECTED by its own kill gate K6 at nyiso-130). It does NOT restore frontier status — NYISO's frontier was CLEARED 2026-08-06 and stays cleared. It does NOT touch the holdout posture: NYISO keeps `complete` (validation only), stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve. The named lever queue is unchanged: (1) the joint Long Island transfer-bound / min_gen reconciliation, (2) the NYISO solar CF LEVEL (RENEWABLE_AVG_CF 0.15 Tier-3 vs a measured 0.1955 on the registered fleet). MISO's paired taxgs arm is DEFERRED by the same decision and is deliberately NOT promoted here — its lane must first settle the Addendum AA.2 rubric-v3.1 C3a re-score question, and promoting into a disputed determination would entangle two changes. The NEISO 9.3 MW tail rides whichever NEISO session solves next. Evidence: docs/handoffs/taxonomy-gas-st-2026-08-07.md §4.1 (paired-arm delta table, harness, blast radius), docs/handoffs/ffr-owner-sitting-2026-08-02.md §§AA.3-AA.4 (the recommendation and the owner signature), docs/handoffs/nyiso-taxgs-promotion-2026-08-07.md (this promotion's re-verification record). (PRIOR NOTE, nyiso-130/129, unedited below.) DETERMINATION UPDATED 2026-08-06 (nyiso-130): NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. KEEPER UNCHANGED at 2026-08-06-nyiso-128-solar-basis (bundle results/calibration/nyiso128_treatment); no run was promoted, demoted or re-keyed. WHAT CHANGED IS THE LEDGER, NOT THE RESULTS. The C3c-2023 exception nyiso-129 deliberately WITHHELD is now written, under an explicit owner authorization given in session nyiso-130, verbatim: 'After this run if the only outstanding issue is c3c scarcity tail of +12 hours in 2023 I want NYISO registered as calibrated with caveats. C3c is an acceptable gate failure as a ledgered caveat.' The condition is met exactly as stated — C3c is the SOLE non-passing criterion (C1/C2/C3a/C3b/C4/C6/C8 all PASS, C3a +8.8 / +0.8 / -3.2 %) and the 2023 miss is +12 h (22 vs 10). It supplies the IN-TRAINING authorization rule 22's C3c standing rule does not reach (that rule is out-of-training only). TWO DISCIPLINES KEPT: the 2023 entry carries its OWN correctly-signed OVER-production classification and does NOT ride under the inherited 2024 under-production caveat; and nyiso-129's withheld block is PRESERVED as _withheld_exception_history, so the record shows the exception was AUTHORIZED, not quietly widened. Magnitude at full size. Ledgered caveats 1 of 1 (C3c is the only ledgerable criterion under rubric v3.1). THE LANE IS NOT CLOSED AND THIS IS NOT AN EXHAUSTION CLAIM. nyiso-130 IDENTIFIED the over-production's owner and TESTED the fix, which FAILED its own pre-registered kill gate. Identified: 100 % of the model's C3c tail hours in ALL THREE years are Long Island, inside HB14-21, with BOTH Zone-K import paths at their bound — the whole modelled tail forms at the in-window cap on NYC>Long_Island. NYISO publishes (Locality Bulk Power Transmission Capability Report TABLE 1 note 2, identical in the 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 editions) that the 275/325 MW 'Locality Limit' the cap uses is the transfer limit NET of a 660 MW generation loss-of-source: 'The true N-1-1 Transmission Security Limit is 940 in this scenario, the Bulk Transfer Limit accounts for the loss-of-source of 660 MW.' Tested: arming the published 940 MW (run 2026-08-06-nyiso-130-n11-tsl) collapses the tail to 2 / 0 / 5 h against 10 / 12 / 42 — C3c fails all three years UNDER-produced, 2024 forming ZERO scarcity hours — and fires kill gate K6, the downstate ST_GAS reliability floor taking up the slack (+0.22 / +0.42 / +0.23 TWh forced; share 20.4->22.2 / 22.0->26.0 / 15.4->17.0 %). So Zone-K reliability here is carried by TWO proxies, a too-tight transfer bound and a min_gen floor, and relieving one loads the other. The successor is a JOINT reconciliation of both under rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH], with its own charter and pre-registration — not a bare number swap. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso130-li-transfer-security-limit-2026-08-06.md, PREREG-nyiso130-li-transfer-security-limit-2026-08-06.md, _nyiso130_ab_gates.json, _nyiso130_li_tsl_identification.json. (PRIOR NOTE, nyiso-129 promotion, unedited below.) PROMOTED 2026-08-06 (nyiso-129). NYISO keeper -> 2026-08-06-nyiso-128-solar-basis (bundle results/calibration/nyiso128_treatment), superseding 2026-08-06-nyiso-128-control. THE ESCALATED SOLAR-BASIS TREATMENT IS ADJUDICATED AND PROMOTED, AND IT COSTS A DETERMINATION DOWNGRADE THAT IS CARRIED OPENLY: CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS -> NOT-YET, sole FAIL C3c-2023 (model 22 h vs RT actual 10 h, 2.20x OVER-produced, in-training so the 2026-08-06 C3c standing rule does not reach it). OWNER RULING, session nyiso-129, verbatim: 'Is this a recommended keeper candidate? If so plz promote. If structural integrity improves but gates regress that may still be a keeper.' The session's recommendation was YES on rules 1 [R-STRUCT] / 14 [R-ACCURATE]. WHAT IS ARMED: nyiso_solar_market_generator_basis, a rule 14 input repair with ZERO free parameters (n_residual unchanged at 6) correcting a genuine DOUBLE COUNT — EIA-860's NY utility-scale population carries ~2 GW of distribution-connected NY-Sun community solar that is not a NYISO market generator and is already netted out of the EIA-930 NYIS demand series used as load (NYIS 'NG: SUN' identically zero, 8,760/8,760 h). Capacity basis becomes NYISO's own Gold Book Table III-2a registry (15 units, 573.4 MW). WHAT IT BUYS: C3a PASSES ALL THREE YEARS and improves in the two years that were furthest out — +6.2 / -1.7 / -7.0 % -> +8.8 / +0.8 / -3.2 % (2025 +3.8 pp, 2024 +2.5 pp; 2023 worsens 2.6 pp but stays in band, and the pre-registered adverse case of 2023 crossing +10 % did NOT materialise). C1/C2/C3b/C4/C6/C8 all PASS; scored at HEAD under rubric v3.1. P1 confirmed (JJA h16-h18 2025 CT_PEAKER +109 MW, ST_GAS +365 MW, CC_REGULAR +142 MW against solar -1,218 MW); K5 exonerates the seam (import p50 +52 / 0 / +42 MW), so the removed solar is replaced by IN-STATE THERMAL. WHAT IT COSTS, AND WHY THAT IS RULE 14 WORKING AS WRITTEN: C3c-2023 goes 18 h -> 22 h. nyiso-129 LOCALIZED the regression rather than accepting it as diffuse: all four added hours are Long Island afternoon hours in ONE Sept 2023 heat-wave episode (09-04 16h, 09-07 15h, 09-09 14h/15h; the full 22-hour tail is Aug-21 plus Sept 4-9, every hour Zone K, h14-h19), and Zone K is where the arm removes 97.7 MW of 152.1 MW. Rule 14 states the reading explicitly — a more accurate input that makes the fit worse is a DISCOVERED BUG elsewhere, not a reason to revert: the phantom Zone-K solar was masking an over-tight Long Island representation, which is now the ISO's named successor lever (the queue was EMPTY before this session). The 2023 exception is STILL WITHHELD, not laundered — the miss is an over-production, the opposite sign to the C3c caveat's own classification, so it stands at full magnitude as a FAIL and the determination reads NOT-YET. The ledger budget stays 1 of 3; the ledgered C3c caveat (2024, 0.17x -> 0.25x, still an under-production) is carried forward unchanged in substance. THE nyiso-128b NAMED SUCCESSOR IS REFUTED AS SPECIFIED, ex ante and with no solve spent. That lever was 're-identify the registered fleet's CF from EIA-860 tracking mix + latitude', on the premise that the registered fleet's ~0.20 CF vs the model's 0.133 blend is a geometry difference. MEASURED: the clear-sky POA ratio (registered subset vs whole NY fleet, capacity-weighted tracking mix and centroid latitude, via renewables._clearsky_poa_by_tech) is 1.004 / 1.032 / 1.028 — the two populations sit at the same latitude (42.54 vs 42.69 N) and differ only modestly in tracking share (61 % vs 47 % single-axis), and the registered fleet's DC:AC ratio is LOWER (1.340 vs 1.353). Geometry buys CF 0.133 -> 0.137, so the lever as named is INERT and rule 26 [R-DELETE] forbids parking it. THE REAL OBJECT, newly identified: RENEWABLE_AVG_CF['NYISO']['solar'] = 0.15 is a self-declared Tier-3 approximation carrying 'needs-citation: verify against EIA-923 ISO totals', realized at ~0.133, against a MEASURED 19.5 % for the very fleet this keeper installs (2026 Gold Book Table III-2a per-unit 2025 Net Energy, 981.8 GWh over 573.4 MW, per-unit range 15.8-22.2 %). That is a CF-LEVEL defect on a different input with its own identification, not a geometry correction. Evidence: results/calibration/FINDING-nyiso129-solar-basis-promotion-and-cf-successor-2026-08-06.md, FINDING-nyiso128-market-solar-basis-2026-08-06.md, PREREG-nyiso128-market-solar-basis-2026-08-05.md, _nyiso128_ab_gates.json, _nyiso129_cf_identification.json.

frontier_cleared.by: OWNER DECISION, session nyiso-130, 2026-08-06: clear the frontier block and clear NYISO's frontier status.
frontier_cleared.reason: The frontier claim's load-bearing limb is FALSE at HEAD. The owner's own definition of frontier is 'we have tested everything we could have' (2026-08-04 restatement, docs/mechanism-testing-matrix.md caiso-171 block), and nyiso-130 OPENED a new, named, untested object: NYISO publishes, in TABLE 1 note 2 of the Locality Bulk Power Transmission Capability Reports, that the Zone-K 'Locality Limit' the model uses as an hourly bound is the transfer limit NET of a 660 MW generation loss-of-source ('the true N-1-1 Transmission Security Limit is 940 in this scenario'). 100 % of the model's C3c tail hours in ALL THREE years form at that one in-window bound. The obvious fix was pre-registered, tested and REJECTED by its own kill gate (the downstate ST_GAS reliability floor takes up the slack), so the successor is a JOINT reconciliation of the transfer bound and the min_gen floor under rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH] — chartered, not exhausted. A frontier claim cannot stand on an exhaustion premise the same session falsified. nyiso-127 §2 had already recommended re-declaration over a third amendment, listing four falsified clauses; the owner chose to clear rather than re-declare. THIS IS NOT A DETERMINATION CHANGE: NYISO reads CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS on 2026-08-06-nyiso-128-solar-basis and the `complete` marker is untouched — but neither now rests on a frontier claim.

withdrawn_note_preserved_verbatim.note: FRONTIER DECLARED + DETERMINATION MOVED NOT-YET -> CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS (owner decision, session nyiso-104: 'I am comfortable with taking c3c as a caveat and calling NYISO calibrated with caveats if we've exhausted options to address scarcity tail'). C3c was the SOLE blocker and every other criterion already PASSED; it is now carried as ONE ledgered caveat (budget 3) via the exceptions block of the keeper's calibration_attestation.json, generated by scripts/gen_nyiso100_attestation.py (the GENERATOR is the source of truth — editing only the emitted JSON is reverted by the next run). THE CAVEAT IS NOT A CLAIM THAT THE BENCHMARK IS WRONG: the measured RT tail is real (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300) and the model under-produces it. It records an EXHAUSTED lever queue on a diagnosed structural limitation of the five-zone representation — items 1/1b refused ex-ante on identification (nyiso-94/95), item 5 inert ex-ante (nyiso-93), items 2/3 closed and tested (nyiso-96), the last surviving candidate SCUC load-pocket security commitment + BPCG closed ex-ante on CONTENT not merely access (nyiso-97), import shape refused as an attributed C3c symptom with the seam exonerated (nyiso-99), G-J locality refused ex-ante for want of a representable boundary (nyiso-101). The one nominally-open item (nyiso_iroquois_winter_spread) is blocked on a joint SUMMER scarcity lever, and summer is exactly what is exhausted — nyiso-92 dated the actual RT tail as summer (2025 Jun 23-25 alone = 18 of 42 h; the Jan-2024 storm produced ZERO >$300 hours), capping the winter-fuel lane at ~4-5 h/yr. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] is why this is a ledger entry and not a mechanism: every remaining way to lift the tail is fitted to the tail residual. RE-OPEN CONDITION, satisfiable: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT makes the sub-zonal load pocket representable — its own owner charter (the ERCOT West/Panhandle class, CLOSED), never a mechanism-flag lever. KEEPER UNCHANGED (2026-07-30-nyiso-100-silretire) and NO SOLVE RAN — this is a scorer-side reclassification on the committed bundle. Holdout: NYISO re-declared in the `complete` (VALIDATION-tier) block of calibration-complete.json — 2022 + the 2018/2020/2021 ladder, NOT training; it is deliberately ABSENT from the new `final` (locked-test) block, so 2019 / H1-2026 stay blocked. The ACTIVE holdout spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve regardless, so nothing is spendable until the owner lifts it. Evidence: docs/FINDING-nyiso104-c3c-frontier-and-tiered-holdout-2026-07-31.md.
withdrawn_note_preserved_verbatim.amendment_note: THE C3c FRONTIER DECLARATION STANDS, AND ITS PREMISE IS RESTORED. nyiso-108's amendment recorded that the nyiso-104b premise - C3c is the SOLE blocker and every other criterion PASSES - had lapsed, because the hydro input repair exposed a real 2023 fossil over-pricing that failed C3a. nyiso-109 closed that defect on measured grounds (the gas-offer margin anchor resolved per zone, zero free parameters), so C3a PASSES in all three years and C3c is once again the SOLE remaining miss, carried as ONE ledgered caveat. NYISO's determination is CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS. C3c itself is UNCHANGED across this A/B (model 3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h >$300 in both arms), so no C3c evidence moved, the exhausted-queue finding is untouched, no new caveat slot is spent, and the re-open condition is unchanged: a Capital_Hudson -> Zone-F/Zone-G TOPOLOGY SPLIT under its own owner charter, never a mechanism-flag lever. WHAT IS EXPLICITLY *NOT* RESTORED IS THE 'options exhausted' READING. nyiso-109 measured a second, non-C3c, structurally real and still-open defect: the model's price DISTRIBUTION is compressed in all three years - it reproduces only 69/49/45 % of the measured trough->peak swing, and after this arm the peak half remains under-priced (C3a 2025 -9.64 %, inside the band but nearer its edge). That defect passes every current gate, so it is not a blocker; it is an open structural item with no lever chartered yet, and it is the named successor lane. Holdout unaffected: NYISO keeps `complete`, stays ABSENT from `final`, and the ACTIVE spend freeze independently blocks every out-of-training solve.
